messages:
Andrea P.: Heads up — trying to model per-customer canaries for Dedicated customers. We need per-tenant traffic splits + circuit-breaker isolation. Thoughts on API surface and UX in Console? cc @Rahul K. @Mei L.

Rahul K.: I think API should let you specify traffic slices with weights and an isolation hint. Example:
```
{"canaries": [{"id": "c1","tenant":"acme","weight":0.02,"isolation_level":"dedicated","max_concurrency":50}]}
```
Keep it simple for the Console presets.

Mei L.: Telemetry note: we need per-tenant 95p latency, error-rate, token/s, plus a sampled collection of requests for evals. Also need an automated divert when errors spike.

Tomas R.: Runtime: tag requests with `tenant_id` + `canary_id`. Routing policy can match and pin to dedicated pools. Important: KV cache and prompt-cache must be isolated when `isolation_level` != shared.

Rahul K.: UX idea: Console "Start canary" modal with presets 1%/5%/20%, `isolate` toggle, `max_tokens_during_canary` quota, and a simulated traffic button. Show live health bars.

Mei L.: Guardrails: auto-stop if error-rate > 5% for 1m or 95p latency delta > 200ms. Circuit-breaker should divert to fallback model variant or hosted pool. Also expose an "evacuate" emergency action.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary 1767890123 started for tenant:acme-enterprise weight=2% route=dedicated-pool-3

Mei L.: Also collect trace ids and surface sampled requests under the canary to the "Rollouts" dashboard. Link to eval harness.

Rahul K.: Thinking about quotas — should cap tokens during canary to limit cost exposure (e.g., `quota.tokens_per_minute: 10000`). Console should show estimated cost delta pre-start.

Tomas R.: One runtime caution: we can't run quantized variant and fp16 variant on same worker if they require different kernel paths. If isolation is `pinned`, we must provision separate worker groups.

Rahul K.: API proposal field `isolation_level`: `shared|dedicated|pinned`. `pinned` == tenant-specific workers, `dedicated` can be tenant in dedicated pool but not exclusively pinned.

Mei L.: +1 on that. Also auto-create alerts in Ops when canary starts: `canary.{id}.errors` and `canary.{id}.latency95`.

Andrea P.: Can we get a minimal API PR + Console mock? @Rahul K will draft. @Mei L @Tomas R please add telemetry/runtime constraints. I'll prototype the modal flows.

Rahul K.: I'll open a draft RFC + PR by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
